purpose: Find which single change stops the repetitive, budget-exhausting output seen on revision 1 once the context was large enough (r2, 8192 tokens per request).

revision_1_unchanged.requirement_and_tests: identical bytes; not copied, read from qwen_agent/tasks/chip_final_yield/
revision_1_unchanged.evidence: evidence/chip-yield-agent/ and evidence/context-validation/ are not modified

transport_note: Revision 1 used /v1/chat/completions, which ignores repeat_penalty. Every revision-2 arm, including the control, uses Ollama's native /api/chat with every sampling value set explicitly, so the transport is constant across arms. The control values equal what the revision-1 requests actually used per the server log (evidence/context-validation/server-logs/ollama-11437-20261023T213428Z.err.log: temp 0.000, top_k 40, top_p 1.000, min_p 0.000, typical_p 1.000, repeat_penalty 1.000, repeat_last_n 64, frequency/presence 0.000). Native defaults differ (temp 0.8, top_p 0.9) and are never relied on.

json_v1.note: revision-1 system prompt + JSON schema {code, explanation}

fenced_v1.note: same rules as json_v1; reply = complete solution.py in exactly one ```python block, then at most 3 sentences; no JSON schema. Exactly one block is required (else model_error); the 3-sentence cap is recorded, not enforced.

control.changes_vs_rev1: none (rev-1 format, sampling and model through the revision-2 transport)

B.changes_vs_rev1: sampling only: temperature 0 -> 0.2, repeat_penalty 1.0 -> 1.1, seed 42 (needed for a reproducible non-greedy run)

C.precondition: run only if the 14b model is fully on GPU at 8192 context (/api/ps size_vram == size and offloaded N/N layers); otherwise stop and report VRAM numbers, never run with CPU offload

attempts: Up to 3 proposals per arm in one run, same rules as revision 1: start = proposal 1; model_error -> `python -m qwen_agent retry` (feedback carries the error); policy_blocked -> automatic re-proposal; awaiting_approval -> human approval of the full diff, then pytest; a failed pytest re-proposes with visible-test feedback only. Holdout failures are never sent to the model.
recorded_per_attempt: context shift / truncation in the server-log window of the call
effective sampler values in the server log
visible tests and holdout tests (only after approval)

repetition_rule.definition: repetition = some 8-word phrase occurs >= 5 times, non-overlapping, in the full output text (words = [A-Za-z_'][A-Za-z_'-]*, JSON-escaped newlines read as spaces)
repetition_rule.calibration: 21 earlier outputs that finished with stop: max 2 occurrences, distinct-8-gram ratio >= 0.96; 5 revision-1 outputs cut at max_tokens: min 38 occurrences, ratio <= 0.39
